advisor_identified: Historian of American political history and foreign policy, York University History Department from 1970; later Distinguished Research Professor Emeritus.

doctorate.title: The Federal Regulation of Railroads in the United States, 1877-1916

evidence.says: York University Archives, Gabriel Kolko fonds F0339: Kolko received his PhD at Harvard in 1962 and joined the History Department at York University in 1970.

Bradley and Donway, Reconsidering Gabriel Kolko (2013), p. 576, lists The Federal Regulation of Railroads in the United States, 1877–1916 as Gabriel Kolko’s 1962 Harvard PhD dissertation. Page 563 identifies Railroads and Regulation as an expanded version of that dissertation.
The Journal of Contemporary Asia obituary confirms his Harvard PhD, his move to York’s History Department in 1970, and that Railroads and Regulation (1965) was based on his doctoral thesis.

notes: The linked record matches the independently documented institution, year and dissertation title. The later book title, Railroads and Regulation, 1877–1916, differs from the dissertation title.
